characterList.description: A middle-aged black man, bald with a short beard, often wears a tie and vest. He plays a strict but loving father role.
characterList.name: Mr. Harper (The Lawyer aka "Papa Bear")

characterList.description: A young black woman with long, curly hair. She is stylish and often seen with makeup and trendy clothes. She is the daughter who desires a lavish prom experience.
characterList.name: Mia ("Fashion Diva")

characterList.description: A young black woman with tight, curly hair. She appears more grounded and responsible compared to her sister, Mia.
characterList.name: Mandy ("Miss Responsible")

content_metadata.description: A story about a teenage girl's longing for a lavish prom experience and her father's attempts to instill responsibility and values, exploring themes of materialism, family dynamics, and personal growth.

activities.description: Walking down the hall, talking, applying lipstick.

characterInteraction.description: The group of friends displays a close bond, sharing excitement and details about prom.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The girls' focus on material aspects of prom, like designer clothes and snacks, suggests a focus on superficiality and social status.

mood.description: Excited - The fast cuts, upbeat music, and girls' conversation contribute to a sense of excitement and anticipation.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduces a group of high school girls eagerly discussing prom plans, setting up the context for the story.

scenes.thematicElements: Teenage friendship, prom, anticipation, consumerism (desire for designer clothing).
scenes.title: Hallway Anticipation

videoEditingDetails.description: Fast cuts between production company logos.

activities.description: Mia negotiates with her father, Mandy watches.

characterInteraction.description: Mia displays persistence and a desire for material possessions, while Mr. Harper tries to balance his love for his daughter with instilling responsibility and values. Mandy observes the dynamic.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Mr. Harper's questioning of Mia's reading habits suggests a concern about her priorities and a desire for her to focus on intellectual and personal growth over material desires.

mood.description: Tense - The dialogue between Mia and her father contributes to a sense of tension and negotiation.

narrativeProgression.description: Mia tries to persuade her father to fund her prom expenses, showcasing a typical father-daughter dynamic.

scenes.title: Negotiation with Father

activities.description: Walking down the hall, talking, applying makeup.

characterInteraction.description: Mia shows frustration and impatience with her father's rules, causing friction within the group. Mandy tries to reason with her sister, highlighting her more pragmatic approach.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Mia's reaction to her father's condition highlights a potential lack of understanding about the value of learning and financial responsibility.

mood.description: Shifts from Excited to Frustrated - The girls initially display excitement for prom plans, but Mia's frustration with her father's conditions dampens the mood.

narrativeProgression.description: The girls finalize their prom plans, but Mia's inability to go shopping due to her father's conditions leads to conflict.

scenes.title: Frustration Unfolds

activities.description: Dialogue between father and daughters, brief moments of affection.

characterInteraction.description: The scene reveals a more vulnerable side of Mia and a glimpse into the wisdom behind Mr. Harper's actions. Mandy's presence adds a layer of support and understanding.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Mr. Harper's guidance through books and his insistence on responsible behavior suggests a father's desire to equip his daughter with values and life lessons.

mood.description: Reflective, Emotional - The music and the more serious tone of the dialogue contribute to a reflective and emotional mood.

narrativeProgression.description: The scene explores the deeper meaning behind Mr. Harper's actions and emphasizes the importance of a father's love and guidance.

scenes.thematicElements: Fatherly love, trust, long-term perspective, personal growth, sacrifice.
scenes.title: Fatherly Wisdom

videoEditingDetails.description: Fast cuts and scene changes between Mia talking to her father in different locations (bedroom, living room) interspersed with shots of the father reading.
End credits superimposed on the last shot.

climax.description: Mr. Harper reassures Mia and advises her to trust his decisions.

storylines.description: The film revolves around Mia's desire for a lavish prom, her negotiation with her father, and the underlying familial love and values.

A Father’s Love
Streams Nation Wide June 16th 17th 18th and 19th
http://www.fatherslovemovie.com
 

From the Dumas Brothers, comes a powerful new film that will captivate audiences everywhere . A Father’s Love, Streams  June 16th, 17th, 18th and19th. 
Fatherslovemovie.com

Mandy and Mia recently lost their mom and are coping with her passing in their own way.
Mandy, a daddy's girl, constantly trying to look out for her younger sister, Mia, who was really close to their mom. Jealous of Mandy for being close with their father while she clashes with him and feels overlooked, Mia harbors anger and resentment towards Mandy to cover up the grief she is going through with their mom's death.Can their father find a way to mend the hearts of his hurting daughters and bring them closer together.

http://www.fatherslovemovie.com
